key.name: request-timeout
key.description: How long to wait for the wallet's NIP-47 response. Requests also carry a matching NIP-40 expiration so the wallet will not execute them later.

key.name: approval-timeout
key.description: An unanswered approval dialog is treated as "Deny" after this long.

key.name: always-confirm-payments
key.description: Ask before every payment, even when it fits the application's daily budget.

key.name: max-auto-pay-msat
key.description: Payments above this amount are always confirmed, whatever the daily budget. 0 means no per-payment cap.

key.name: trusted-apps
key.description: Application ids allowed to pair/unpair and to read or change other applications' budgets without a confirmation dialog.
